name: Glin UI
summary: Liquid Glass React components on Radix and Tailwind — package or CLI copy.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 76+ production components — not full inventory.
Vue path is tokens-only; React/@glinui/ui is the primary ingest surface.
Some primitives also listed under /docs/components/radix/* — this batch uses the public /docs/components/{slug} docs routes that return HTTP 200.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Glass Card
components.summary: Frosted card with depth-aware blur and refraction edges.
components.copyCode:
pnpm add @glinui/ui @glinui/tokens
# or CLI: pnpm dlx @glinui/cli@latest add glass-card
# or: npx glinui add glass-card

import { GlassCard } from "@glinui/ui"
import "@glinui/tokens/theme.css"

<GlassCard />

copyPrompt.text: Use Glin UI free MIT React component `Glass Card` (slug `glass-card`) from https://glinui.com/docs/components/glass-card. Install with `pnpm add @glinui/ui @glinui/tokens` then `import { GlassCard } from "@glinui/ui"` and `import "@glinui/tokens/theme.css"`, or copy source via `pnpm dlx @glinui/cli@latest add glass-card` / `npx glinui add glass-card`. Getting started: https://glinui.com/docs/getting-started. Home: https://glinui.com. Repo: https://github.com/GLINCKER/glinui. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GLINCKER/glinui/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2026 Glincker LLC). Pricing free. npm: @glinui/ui.
